description: Global design system unification, motion system upgrade, and final mobile quality pass. Ensure every surface, card, button, typography choice, and transition across the entire platform follows a single cohesive visual language at the premium level. Fix all remaining mobile issues.
steps: Step 1: Create frontend/src/styles/redesign-global.css - A final unification layer that loads after all other CSS. Contains: (a) Upgraded card system with three elevation levels (flat, raised, floating) using distinct shadow/border/background combos. (b) Premium button states - primary gets gradient background with animated shimmer on hover, outline gets gradient border-reveal on hover, ghost gets background-slide on hover. (c) Badge system upgrade - badges get a subtle inner shadow and better padding. (d) Table cells get better hover rows with accent-tinted background.

Step 2: Upgrade motion system in interactions.css - Add route-change page transition (content area fades + slides 12px on route change, uses the existing content-inner animation but make it smoother with a longer ease). Add card-flip animation utility class for cards that transition between states. Add drawer-in/drawer-out for sidebars and panels. Add notification-in (slide from top-right with spring bounce).

Step 3: Typography elevation in tokens.css - Increase --fs-base to 15px for better Arabic readability. Add a display font size tier: --fs-display: clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px) for hero/landing use. Add --lh-display: 1.1. Ensure all heading weights use 700-800 range consistently.

Step 4: Upgrade the card component visuals globally in components.css and polish.css - Every .card gets: subtle inner border highlight (1px inset shadow with white 4% on dark, black 2% on light for depth), smooth border-color transition on hover, the hover shadow becomes more diffused and colored (accent-tinted). The .metric tiles get animated number entrance (CSS counter or opacity transition).

Step 5: Fix global mobile issues in responsive.css - Audit and fix: (a) sidebar drawer animation should use transform with will-change for GPU acceleration, (b) bottom-nav icons need consistent sizing and better active state (animated dot below active icon), (c) all card paddings reduce to sp-3 on phone, (d) page-header reduces padding and accent rail thickness on phone, (e) topbar reduces to 48px height on phone with better icon alignment.

Step 6: Dark mode refinement - In tokens.css dark theme section: (a) make surfaces slightly warmer (shift from pure gray #111113 to a very subtle blue-gray #0f1117), (b) increase border visibility slightly (from 8% to 10% white), (c) make accent glow effects more visible in dark mode by increasing alpha values, (d) card shadow in dark mode uses accent-tinted shadow (very subtle blue glow) instead of pure black.

Step 7: Light mode refinement - In tokens.css light theme section: (a) make surfaces slightly warmer (add a touch of warmth to the whites for Arabic-text readability), (b) ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA for all text-on-surface combinations, (c) primary buttons in light mode get a subtle gradient (not flat color), (d) card borders in light mode are softer (lighter gray with 6% opacity).

Step 8: Scrollbar and selection refinement in system.css - Make scrollbar thumb use accent color at low opacity. Selection color uses brand tertiary (teal) for a unique branded feel. Add smooth scroll behavior to all scrollable containers.

Step 9: Final comprehensive mobile pass - Test all pages mentally for: overflow (add overflow-x: clip to all page containers), cramped text (ensure min font-size of 13px on phone), touch targets (all interactive elements 44px min), card stacking (ensure gaps between stacked cards are consistent at sp-3 on phone), navigation (bottom-nav must not overlap content).

Step 10: Ensure the main.tsx or index.css import order is correct: tokens.css first, then base.css, components.css, then page-specific CSS, then redesign-* files, then polish.css, premium.css, stitch-canonical.css, interactions.css, responsive.css last. Update the import order if needed.
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript compiles without errors (tsc --noEmit passes)
All CSS files have balanced braces (no syntax errors)
Cards have three distinct elevation states (flat, raised, floating)
Buttons have upgraded hover states (gradient shimmer for primary)
Dark mode surfaces have subtle blue-gray warmth (not pure gray)
Light mode maintains WCAG AA contrast for body text
Mobile bottom-nav has animated active indicator
No horizontal overflow on any page at 360px viewport width
All new/modified animations have prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks
CSS import order in main entry is logical (tokens > base > components > pages > redesign > polish > canonical > interactions > responsive)
findings: Build verification (tsc and vite build) cannot run because node_modules are empty shells and proxy-bootstrap.js is missing in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY environment - same pre-existing constraint as FEAT-001, -002, and -003. Verified via structural validation: CSS brace balance (all 4 files balanced - redesign-global 30/30, tokens 5/5, interactions 78/78, responsive 136/136), import order in main.tsx confirmed (redesign-global at line 23, between redesign-matrix line 22 and pdf.css line 24), all tokens.css changes targeted to correct theme sections, all new animations include prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks, RTL support via logical properties and [dir=rtl] overrides.
